subject: MATHEMATICS
purpose: Release policy for learner-visible mathematics. Mathematical meaning is carried by structure; a renderer may not recover structure that was destroyed upstream. Therefore every learner-visible mathematical object enters publication as a MathExpression AST and is typeset, never string-substituted.
principle: Mathematics is a structured object, not an opaque string passed through an ASCII-safe renderer.

render_targets.UNICODE: Accessibility/audit surface. Must contain the exact bound glyphs, real script characters and real radical signs.
render_targets.TYPESET: Measured, drawn surface. Fractions get a real rule, radicals a real overbar, scripts a real raised/lowered baseline at reduced size.

font_policy.required_glyph_coverage: every code point produced by the expression corpus

release_meaning: Passing these gates is PUBLICATION_ENGINEERING evidence only. It does not constitute subject, pedagogy, assessment or expert review, all of which remain PENDING.
